subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): generic outbound delivery-report seam; WhatsApp native auto-reply reports provider-accepted sends

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw/plugin-sdk/outbound-delivery-report` as the public contract for channel self-delivery sent-event reporting?
rationale: This PR adds a new release-facing Plugin SDK subpath and permanent idempotency semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the API shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after contract guard and proof
options.body: Require the API baseline metadata/hash fix plus redacted WhatsApp/runtime proof, then review the exact SDK shape for merge.

options.title: Rename or redesign the seam
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and ask for a narrower or differently named SDK contract before this branch proceeds.

options.title: Decline the public API
options.body: Close or pause the PR and handle remaining WhatsApp behavior through existing channel-local delivery mechanisms instead.

recommendation.title: Accept after contract guard and proof
recommendation.body: Require the API baseline metadata/hash fix plus redacted WhatsApp/runtime proof, then review the exact SDK shape for merge.
